This course uses the ISGS portfolio for studying and advising to document supervisory and academic activities and track learning progress.
The specific content of guidance, academic activities, and learning outcomes varies depending on the student's research topic and the advisor’s supervisory approach. Therefore, students should consult a main advisor for detailed information.
履修条件
授業概要
・ 博士論文の完成のために主指導教員が毎学期実施する研究指導である。研究計画の立案から、 調査、論文執筆にいたるまで、個々の学生に応じた指導を実施する。
・ 博士後期課程１年次前期には、希望指導教員団の選定や研究テーマの吟味、今後の研究計画について指導を受け、博士論文執筆計画書を提出する。
・ 毎学期、当該学期の研究の成果を振り返り、計画を再検討して、博士論文執筆計画書にまとめ、主指導教員の所見と指導教員段の承認を受け、提出する。
・This course provides research guidance from your main advisor each semester to support the completion of your doctoral dissertation. Your advisor will offer guidance on research planning, investigation, and dissertation writing while addressing your individual needs.
・In the first semester of your first year in the Doctoral Program, you will receive guidance on selecting your advisory committee members, refining your research theme, and developing your research plan. You will then submit your Doctoral Dissertation Writing Plan.
・Each semester, you will review the research outcomes of that term, revise your plan as needed, and compile them into the Doctoral Dissertation Writing Plan. This plan must be reviewed by your main advisor, approved by the advisory committee, and submitted.
